caption: Ancient Theater, Delphi
composition: Theater cavea above the temple terrace at Delphi · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From high in the ancient theater, curved rows of seats fill the foreground and the Temple of Apollo is a smaller partial colonnade on the terrace below, with the Phaedriades behind. The sky is clear, about 11.1°C. This is a wide sanctuary view, distinct from the close temple frame of GR-01-005. No floodlight schedule was found, and the moon is down, so the stone is in twilight only.
